items.notes: 启元机器人的动作条件多视角机器人世界模型模拟器，输入各相机首帧、文字提示和机器人动作轨迹，生成后续三视角视频，用于策略评估和基于 GRPO 的策略优化；发布中训练底座和第 4 阶段因果少步推理两个检查点。
items.notes_en: Primebot's action-conditioned multi-view robot world-model simulator: given each camera's first frame, a text prompt and a robot action trajectory, it generates the following three-view video, used for policy evaluation and GRPO-based policy optimization. Two checkpoints: the midtrained base and the stage-4 causal few-step model.

items.name: Atlas
items.realtime_claim: Frameboy 研究预览：云端 GPU 推流到浏览器，最高 15 fps（随相机控制实时生成）
items.length_claim: 最长 1 分钟视频
items.vram_note: 官方称 Frameboy 目前必须在云端高性能 GPU 服务器上运行
items.notes: World Labs 从零预训练的全模态自回归扩散世界模型，可处理文本、图像、相机位姿和 3D 深度图，按指定相机轨迹生成最长 1 分钟 1440p 视频，或输出点云和 3D 高斯泼溅；完整模型对选定合作方早期开放，公众可在 Frameboy 研究预览中实时探索预设场景，官方称将驱动后续版本的 Marble。
items.notes_en: World Labs' omni autoregressive diffusion world model pretrained from scratch on text, images, camera poses and 3D depth maps; it generates up to one minute of 1440p video along a specified camera path or outputs point clouds and 3D Gaussian splats. The full model is in early access with select partners, the public can explore curated scenes in real time via the Frameboy research preview, and World Labs says it will power future versions of Marble.

items.name: Matrix-Game 4.0
items.realtime_claim: RTX 5090 单卡 480p 60 FPS、按键到显示延迟 112ms；固定提示词时 RTX 5080 67 FPS、RTX 5070 Ti 58 FPS（官方，稳态模型吞吐，不含视频 I/O）

items.notes: 把可执行游戏引擎与因果视频模型拆开：引擎负责玩法、物理和玩家输入，模型把引擎渲染的低多边形画面流式重渲染为精细画面；随附中世纪城堡、古埃及、城市赛车三个场景的权重与游戏资源。
items.notes_en: Separates an executable game engine from a causal video model: the engine handles gameplay, physics and player input, while the model streams a detailed re-rendering of the engine's low-poly frames; weights and game assets are released for Medieval Castle, Ancient Egypt and City Racing scenes.

items.name: Puffin-World-Pro
items.org: 南洋理工大学 S-Lab NTU S-Lab、大晓机器人 ACE Robotics 等
items.notes: 以相机为中心的统一多模态世界模型，把重力/纬度、深度和外观作为原生 3D 世界状态，给定一张初始图和相机轨迹生成多视角 RGB-D 画面并重建 3D 点云，目前只处理静态场景；Pro 版用于高质量生成与 RGB-D 世界建模。
items.notes_en: Camera-centric unified multimodal world model that treats gravity/latitude, depth and appearance as native 3D world states; from one initial view and a camera trajectory it generates multi-view RGB-D views and a 3D point cloud (static scenes only). The Pro checkpoint targets high-quality generation and RGB-D world modeling.
